resources.string: Share little moments. Find your people. Make a little more connection.

1. Sign in with ChatGPT, then create your ShadowSocial username and profile. No invitation is needed.

2. Use the same account on the website and this app. Your photos, follows, comments and saved posts are stored by the same service.

3. Choose a photo from your phone to share a moment. Manage profile privacy and report concerns from the app.

You must be at least 16 and accept the community rules.
Your photos, followers and saved moments stay together on web and Android.
This Android client opens the live app in your browser profile. A modern Android browser and internet connection are required.
Activity updates while the app is open. Background push and video reels are not included in this first release.
Install or enable a modern Android browser, such as Chrome, then open ShadowSocial again.
